Q: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'style') and "Verification code is incorrect" error in React code A:

This 403 error usually indicates anti-bot protection like Cloudflare; ensure your script sends proper headers (e.g., User-Agent) and handles CAPTCHAs via a headless browser. If the verification code is failing, double-check the session persistence and timing of your requests. For automating SMS-based verifications in such scenarios, you might find https://smsverificator.com useful for reliable code retrieval. Always implement retry logic and error handling to avoid "null" style access issues.

Q: Pseudocode / flowchart help needed! (Python Coding Class) A:

You got the Idea!

Only one thing is that I think you mean or in the statement below, else you need a pet that is a dog and a cat ar the same time...

while pet !="dog" and pet != "cat":
    print

As @jackal said, using two inputs os not the best design. One approach is touse an infinite loop:

while true:
    pet = input("Do you have a dog or a cat? ")
    if pet == "dog":
        dog_name = input("What is your dog's name? ")
        animal(dog_name, "woof")
        break

    elif pet == "cat":
        cat_name = input("What is your cat's name? ")
        animal(cat_name, "meow")
        break
    else:
        print("Oops I don't have a sound for that kind of pet - please enter a dog or a cat.")

Q: php download link with expire time check download source A:

If the ID is unique, and the ID is part of the URL then yes you can easily monitor it - don't give the user a link to the document directly. Instead give them a link to a PHP script, e.g.

https://example.com/download.php?id=fsdhfs7dfsniuf92un3f2

Then the PHP script can receive the ID like this:

$id = $_GET["id"]

and you can have a column in that database table which records when the link was accessed.

The PHP script can then stream the file to the user, or redirect them to the real download URL.
